sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status table)

values.note: 20 sites with tent pad, fire grate and table. The forest's status table gives a 33-ft maximum spur; the campground page says spurs run 30 to 70 ft and calls it 'well-suited for larger RVs' (paved interior road, longer spurs). RVs must fit on the spur: no parking off road.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Dutch George Flats: Sites 20, Max Spur 33') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/dutch-george-campground ('There are 20 sites'; 'The parking length ranges from 30 to 70 feet'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/dutch-george-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status: Dutch George Flats, Operating Season May 15 - Sept 20), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come, first-served only; not listed on recreation.gov. Up to eight people per site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/dutch-george-campground ('There are 20 sites available on a first-come, first-served basis'; 'First come, first served campground'; 'A single site may hold up to eight people') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('First-come, first-served') + recreation.gov search (no Dutch George facility), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $29 a site (FS page and the forest's status table).

note: ~6,500 ft beside Hwy 14 and the Cache la Poudre: an open flat with cottonwood and ponderosa shade along the river at some sites; paved interior road. --Claude
summary: FS campground page + ARP Campground Status table: confirmed 20 sites, first-come only (no recreation.gov listing), vault toilets, potable water, $29. Added max spur 33 ft (status table; the page says 30-70 ft), season May 15 - Sept 20. Phone missing: Canyon Lakes RD office 970-295-6600. Note trimmed.
flags: Missing phone: Canyon Lakes Ranger District Office, 970-295-6600 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/offices; the ARP routes every district office and the supervisor's office through this one number).

Spur length conflict: the ARP Campground Status table gives Max Spur 33 ft; the campground page says 'The parking length ranges from 30 to 70 feet' and 'well-suited for larger RVs'. Recorded 33; both clear 23 ft.

Waterfront (stored riverfront): no per-site coordinates exist (not on recreation.gov). On imagery the loop lies on the flat between Hwy 14 and the Poudre; the spurs along its south side sit roughly 20-60 m from the river with a strip of riparian trees, the inner and north-side sites farther. Only the river-side sites look riverfront; not re-audited here.
Name: the FS page titles it 'Dutch George Campground'; the forest's status table uses 'Dutch George Flats'.
